setup: One SELECT using existing writer-role password file indirectly, TLS verify-full and read-only session; no admin secret retrieval or DDL
query: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_user AS reader_role,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,pg_get_userbyid(datdba) AS database_owner,has_database_privilege('statarena_admin',oid,'CONNECT') AS admin_connect,has_database_privilege('statarena_admin',oid,'CREATE') AS admin_create FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()
limits: Role/database capability only; not an actual administrative schema apply
